children: Qassim Medical Services Company, a subsidiary of SPIMACO, has received shareholder approval to continue preparations for listing part of its shares on Saudi Arabia’s Nomu parallel market. The plan is still in its early stages and will require regulatory approvals before it can move ahead.

The potential issuer generated SAR179.2 million in revenue and SAR31.6 million in net profit in 2025, while SPIMACO’s 57.27% stake had a book value of SAR169 million at year-end 2025, according to an EFG Hermes note seen by Zawya.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Brinda Darasha)

title: SPIMACO subsidiary gears up for an IPO on Saudi Arabia’s parallel market
